term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years, counted from 1 January of the year after death (art. 37(1))
moral_rights: Right to attribution and to object to changes and derogatory treatment (art. 25(1))
orphan_works: Cultural and educational bodies may use works first published in the EU/EEA after a diligent search fails to find the rightholder (arts. 16o-16p)
digital_protection: Circumventing effective technical protection measures is unlawful, and so is trafficking in circumvention tools (art. 29a)
fair_use_exceptions: Quotation (art. 15a), news reporting (art. 15), curriculum teaching by public or non-profit bodies not treated as public performance (art. 12(5))
enforcement_body: Ministry of Justice and Security (Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid)
